notes: This is a 10-request sequential smoke measurement, not a concurrency or capacity test.
An initial request without think=false returned HTTP 200 with empty assistant content; this documented run adds the same option used by app calls and validates that content is nonempty.
Latency excludes model startup because the upstream was already warm.
This captures the host GPU and upstream model, but not GPU utilization, memory, or exact Ollama model digest.
